changes.title: Legend pixels
items: A sleeping legend is now the animal itself lying asleep (curled, tucked or coiled, eyes shut), not a shapeless mossy mound, outlined in its colour
Legends are drawn at the same pixel size as everything else, with stepped pixel shading instead of smooth gradients, and no longer swell as they breathe

changes.title: Respawn decks
items: Knocked down, you come back behind your decks in the treehouse, as at the start of the game (at the normal zoom), and step off when you are ready

changes.title: Audio meter
items: The debug overlay (~) shows what sound is actually leaving the game, and the playtest log (L) notes every time it goes silent while the music should be playing, with where you were
?micCheck=1 lets the game listen through the microphone for sound cutting out after it leaves the game (debug only)
